title: Ha Long travel experience in May
excerpt: Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise Ha Long travel experience in May, about the weather of famous landmarks, resorts and exciting festival events, please refer to it before coming to Ha Long this summer. Ha Lon
html:
Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise Ha Long travel experience in May, about the weather of famous landmarks, resorts and exciting festival events, please refer to it before coming to Ha Long this summer.

Ha Long always leaves visitors with unforgettable memories because of its famous landmarks, delicious dishes and many unique games, each season Ha Long brings visitors a unique beauty, let’s find out what attracts visitors to Ha Long in May.

Ha Long climate in May

Ha Long is an ideal resort destination, Ha Long belongs to the climate of the North and is divided into 4 seasons, but usually has 2 main seasons, which are the rainy season and the dry season, however, visitors often travel to Ha Long all year round.

In particular, tourists often travel to Ha Long most beautifully in the summer, Ha Long resort tours tourists often come to Ha Long in spring and autumn. However, to have time to admire the beautiful scenery of Ha Long Bay, tourists often choose to go on Ha Long tours from March to May and from October to November. However, if you are a person who loves swimming in the sea and participating in games, you should travel to Ha Long in the summer.

Summer weather from December and lasts until January of the following year, the weather is foggy. This is the time when Ha Long is entering the winter, quite cold, many tourists want to choose economical Ha Long tours, so they should go at this time and cannot participate in games on the sea, or swim in the sea because at this time the weather is quite cold, only suitable for Ha Long resort tours.

Ha Long in May, visitors should experience the exciting games on the sea, at this time the weather is clear and there are sudden showers, short rains that will stop immediately so it will not affect the tourist’s itinerary.

If you are a person who loves to admire the scenery, participate in games and enjoy virtual life, do not forget to bring yourself bright-colored dresses to take pictures, next to the blue sea, white sand, and yellow sunshine.

Traveling to Ha Long in May, you should visit Tuan Chau Island, or take a 5-star Ha Long cruise tour, gliding through the famous landscapes, amazing caves, and through the islands in the bay to admire the poetic scenery, especially to welcome the sunrise rising above the sea, a beautiful scene that looks like a poetic painting.

Ha Long tourist attractions in May

Ha Long Bay

Recognized by Unesco as a world natural heritage, there are many small islands, each island has its own beauty, to fully admire the beauty of the bay you can take a motorboat and then experience kayaking to the small islands for sightseeing.

Bai Tu Long Bay

The bay includes many large and small islands, the bay looks like a natural wonder of the world, the islands on the bay are all inhabited, so when coming here, visitors can walk around, sightsee and experience life with the islanders.

Tuan Chau Island

Coming to Tuan Chau Island in May, you will be able to participate in the water music show, and games at the amusement park at the outdoor amusement park or dinosaur park… will bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

Thien Cung Cave

It is one of the caves visited by many tourists, especially when traveling to Ha Long, the weather on the island is sunny, but when entering the cave, visitors will be immersed in the cool air from nature, inside there are stalactites that look very eye-catching.

Ti Top Island

A small island with a long white sandbank and clear blue sea water, from afar the island looks like a crescent moon with many stalls and bars, especially when traveling to Ha Long in May, when coming to Ti Top Island, you should rent swimsuits, jet skis, parachutes to participate in exciting activities on the sea.

Surprise Cave

Looks like a palace with stalactites bestowed by nature, to reach the cave you have to conquer the stone steps, then follow the stone path, the entrance to the cave is colorful lanterns, a beautiful scene.

Above are the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in May that Vietlook has just compiled and shared with tourists. Depending on each person’s preferences, there will be different experiences. With the information that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your upcoming trip.
